# WriteInt <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Streams](BlitzBasic-Streams)

</div>


```blitzbasic
WriteInt:Void stream:Int32, int:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to write to. |
| `int` | In | Int32 | required | The value to write. |

## Description

Writes an integer in 4 bytes, low byte first.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
file = WriteFile("streams_int_example.tmp")
WriteInt file, 123456789
WriteInt file, -42
CloseFile file
file = ReadFile("streams_int_example.tmp")
Print ReadInt(file)
Print ReadInt(file)
CloseFile file
DeleteFile "streams_int_example.tmp"
```

```text
123456789
-42
```
